name: Silo Swarm claim-oriented patent discovery

claim_elements.name: Partitioned multi-agent evidence
claim_elements.description: A plurality of AI agents or processing nodes receives different evidence, context, or role-specific inputs.

claim_elements.name: Parallel typed probabilistic judgments
claim_elements.description: Agents evaluate concurrently and return constrained or structured judgments with confidence or probability information.

claim_elements.name: Connected verification or aggregation stage
claim_elements.description: A later stage receives, aggregates, verifies, or reaches consensus over the earlier outputs or pooled evidence.

claim_elements.name: Deterministic policy composition
claim_elements.description: Non-model rules or a policy engine compose judgments into an action, approval, block, or incident response.

claim_elements.name: Coalitional utility or contribution measurement
claim_elements.description: The system computes utility, superadditive surplus, marginal contribution, Shapley allocation, or coalition value.

claim_elements.name: Isolated-versus-connected visualization
claim_elements.description: A dashboard or interface visualizes agents, evidence partitions, execution graphs, or isolated and connected states.

claim_elements.name: Data-minimized tamper-evident audit evidence
claim_elements.description: Agent actions or decisions are recorded in append-only, signed, hash-linked, HMAC-protected, or otherwise tamper-evident records.

queries: "large language model" structured output confidence aggregation
